propositions: s3_doctor._git calls gitutil.run_git directly without retry wrapper, bypassing self-healing mechanisms available to other store git operations
transient object-database read failures (missing loose objects) cause bundle operations to fail with 'fatal: bad object' when the object becomes temporarily unavailable
the same failure class is handled by retry wrappers in other store paths (gitutil._with_transient_head_retry, event_append transient markers) but not in s3_doctor
S3DoctorConflict error messages misdescribe object-database read failures as head conflicts, directing operators to wrong recovery tools
routing s3_doctor._git through gitutil.run_git_write and adding 'bad object' to transient markers will enable self-healing without new retry logic or backoff policy
